about: Birth-date overrides that need a person to look at them. Each entry lists every source value and the days between them; chosen/chosen_source is what data/bio_birthdate_overrides.json now holds. Rules: NBA.com (www.nba.com/player/<PERSON_ID>, career years checked) wins when it answered; Wikidata P569 is used only for a basketball player whose career matches; entries no source confirms are pinned to the sheet value (source "unresolved"). Kinds: disagreement = NBA.com and Wikidata differ; single_source_contradicts_old = one source only and it differs from the old override value; no_source = neither source gave a full date.
